sections.name: BYD Atto 3
lines: B Y D started as a battery maker, and is now one of the biggest electric car makers in the world.
The Atto three uses B Y D's Blade battery. Long, thin lithium iron phosphate cells, known for being very resistant to catching fire.
The bigger battery is sixty point four eight kilowatt hours, with a claimed range of up to five hundred and twenty one kilometres.
Two hundred and four P S, and zero to one hundred in about seven point three seconds.
It earned five stars in Euro N CAP crash tests.
The interior is wonderfully weird. A screen that rotates, and door pockets strung like a guitar.
It sits on B Y D's dedicated electric platform, with a flat floor.
A safe battery, a quick motor, and an interior with real personality.
